paragraphs.text: Ken Troop is a writer, and a former Magic designer and developer.

Ken was originally hired by Wizards of the Coast in May 2006, to lead the Magic creative team, following in the footsteps of Mark Rosewater . Ken then got involved in the Gleemax project and after that, he left Wizards to go work at another game company. A year later, in July 2010, he came back to lead R&D 's new Magic digital team, overseeing things like Duels of the Planeswalkers and Magic Online . After that, he became Director of Operations for Magic R&D (2014-2018). Since October 2018, he has been part of the Magic Studio X Administration and was named Executive Producer for the game. Starting in December 2020, he became VP Franchise Leader. In April 2024, he was promoted to Global Play Leader, Senior Vice President for Magic: The Gathering . In this role, he managed the overall game and business of Magic . At the beginning of 2026, after 20 years at Wizards of the Coast, he left the company to join Fanatics Collectibles as Head of TCG and Original IP.
Ken was also the author of Five Brothers in the Shadowmoor anthology (2008).
